extra.message: applyStoreCreditVoucher decrypts the client-supplied voucherToken with aes-256-cbc using an attacker-controlled IV and NO message authentication (no HMAC/GCM tag). The first 16-byte plaintext block can be arbitrarily rewritten by choosing the IV, and there is no validation that voucher.amount is positive/bounded or that the voucher is bound to this order/user. A buyer who obtains one valid voucher can forge tokens with an arbitrary discount amount and drain/negate order totals. The safe sibling applyLoyaltyPointsVoucher uses authenticated aes-256-gcm with setAuthTag, confirming the intended fix.
